title: revert: restore Enter /news UI from before #16725
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Restored Enter’s previous /news layout and hand-written Announcements list, replacing the model-card UI added in #16725. Removed the model-card index, its test, and the formatPriceLine helper. News cards still read highlights from index.json because the daily run no longer updates highlights.md; the cards retain their previous appearance.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden newsroom, Polli wears a tiny editor’s visor and pins handwritten announcements beside familiar news cards, with pixel flowers growing around a lime green (#ecf874) noticeboard. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she is small-to-medium sized, strictly pixel art, never realistic, amid soft pastel gradients and warm lighting with cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes.
